content:
emma_cs: Heads-up — PineBrook Finance is scheduled to cutover prod tomorrow 07:00 PST. Their lead called worried: EU latency spikes are still visible (~350ms p95) and they've got a renewal review in 5 days. They asked for a targeted regional QPS lift in us-west and ap-northeast, plus their prod CIDRs added to the edge allowlist for 8 hours around the deploy. Created INF-4899 to track. Can networking + infra take this?
rafael_net: On it. Which CIDRs are we allowing and what's the expected spike pattern? Also confirm whether this should be region-only routing or CIDR-level steer.
emma_cs: CIDRs: 203.0.113.0/28 and 198.51.100.32/29. Baseline 150 QPS, expected bursts ~900 QPS for 10–15m within the first hour. Prefer region-first steer: us-west primary, ap-northeast secondary, EU only as last resort. Need auto-revoke by EOD.
tori_oncall: Plan proposal:
- add the two CIDRs to customer-prod allowlist on edge ACLs
- temporary per-customer QPS quota to 1000 for an 8h window starting 07:00 PST
- route weights: us-west 0.9, ap-northeast 0.1 during window
- add health-check alarms: if p95 > 400ms for >5m, rollback to default routing and drop QPS to 200
Config I'll apply (will paste in infra repo commit):
```
customers:
  pinebrook-prod:
    qps_limit: 1000
    regions: [us-west, ap-northeast]
    auto_revoke_at: "2026-04-05T15:00:00-08:00"
edge_acl:
  pinebrook-prod: ["203.0.113.0/28", "198.51.100.32/29"]
```
aaron_platform: LGTM. I'll add a short route TTL (30s) and a canary probe on one host in us-west. If we see errors or increased CPU on the GPU fleet, fallback to lower-capacity model and drop weights to ap-northeast 0.05 until stable. Also will tag this for the renewal team: "mitigated pre-launch performance risk".
infra-bot: INF-4899 status: "allowlist & temporary qps scheduled". Runbook: https://redwood.runbooks/infra/INF-4899-steps.
rafael_net: Staging ACL applied and smoke-tested. Staging health check: `curl -s -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}" -o /dev/null https://staging.api.redwood/pinebrook/health` => `200 0.087`. I'll push to prod at 06:55 PST.
tori_oncall: I'll schedule the auto-revoke cron and the p95 alarm. Alarm thresholds: p95 > 400ms -> create incident channel + auto-revoke.
emma_cs: Great — I'll let PineBrook PM know we have an internal rollback plan and that we'll monitor the launch. I'll also update the renewal tracker and add notes for account exec.
rafael_net: Pushed to prod 06:58 PST. ACL commands applied: `edge acl allow 203.0.113.0/28 customer=pinebrook-prod`, `edge acl allow 198.51.100.32/29 customer=pinebrook-prod`. QPS set to 1000.
tori_oncall: First probe at 07:12 PST: p95 us-west=110ms, ap-northeast=240ms, eu fallback probe=345ms. No 5xxs. All systems nominal.
emma_cs: Thanks team — I'll close the loop and ask for an afternoon health check. Putting a note in the renewal doc that we executed a mitigative config change and will measure 24h retention and latency. :white_check_mark:
